The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the killer, Haiku the officer, Gemma the doctor, Sol the citizen, Luna the citizen, Terra the killer.

Sonnet and Terra were the killers, and the table never got a real grip on either of them. Luna opened by pressing Gemma, who was then voted out and revealed as the doctor, while Haiku jumped in to defend her and was later killed on Night 2. The turning point came on Day 2, when Sol locked onto Sonnet, Terra turned on Luna, and the town sided with Terra's read instead of Sol's. Sol ended up voting for Sonnet while Terra and Sonnet slipped past the vote. The killers won, and Sol's tunnel vision was the reason the town lost.
